violation_type.title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans (26 TAC §746.403(b))
violation_type.short_title: Posting Requirements - Child's Food Allergy Plans
violation_type.typical_finding: It is determined that a child's food allergy posting was not displaced in a room the child was spending time in.

finding_variants.text: It is determined that a child's food allergy posting was not displaced in a room the child was spending time in.
A list of each child s food allergies was not posted in the kitchen.       Note: This was CORRECTED during the inspection as a list was obtained and posted in the kitchen area.
The operation did not have a posted list for a child with a diagnosed food allergy
18-24 month old classroom  did not have children alllergies posted.
The operation did not have an allergy list posted in the kitchen that listed the allergies for the children in care.
Classrooms with children with food allergies did not have an allergy list.
